data.narrative:
Delian Alliance Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $14M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—including same-sector adjacents UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $14M total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-Series advancement, yielding $35M. Peer-Median analysis references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers with valuations ranging $125M to $1.0B; the median across this set is $400M, reflecting the wide dispersion inherent in early-stage Defense & Security valuations.

The two methods produce a triangulated range of $30M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $218M. The wide dispersion—driven primarily by the Peer-Median method's sensitivity to outliers like UFORCE at $1.0B—reflects material uncertainty around Delian's precise competitive positioning and capital intensity relative to this peer cohort. Stage-Progression anchors conservatively; resolving this range will depend on demonstrating differentiated technology, customer traction, and path to Series funding at the upper quartile of peer multiples.
